terms.comment: Classically a broad flat dish for libations. M-O has only doubtful proposals (suppositōrium?).

phrases.latin: Pōculum in pateram pōne, nē mēnsa madefīat.
phrases.english: Put the cup on the saucer, so the table doesn’t get wet.

sources: Lewis & Short: patera
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. dish: saucer.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, supplied PDF (printed page numbers): p. 124.
